decisive_items: The lesions followed the course of branches of the common plantar digital nerves without evidence of invasion.
On T2-weighted fat-suppressed images, they were homogeneously hyperintense without cystic degeneration; each was surrounded by a hyperintense rim.
response.rationale: The champion candidate R2 is supported by multiple raw spans, including the suspicion of multiple plexiform schwannoma and the lesions' relationship to the common plantar digital nerves. The runner-up candidate C1 is also supported by the lesions' relationship to the nerves, but it is more specific and has fewer supporting spans.

rejected.why: Glomus tumor is less likely due to the imaging findings
Neurofibroma is less likely due to the lack of family history and the imaging characteristics
